title: MERN Content Management System
subtitle: Academic project
description: A high-performance CMS that enables multi-author collaboration, dynamic content updates and secure publication workflows.
highlights: Full CRUD functionality with login and signup authentication.
Secure role-based access control (RBAC) to protect data integrity.

title: Node.js Request Rate Limiter
subtitle: Academic project
description: A middleware that regulates API traffic, enforcing a limit of 1 task per second and 20 tasks per minute for each user.
highlights: Queuing mechanism for burst traffic so excess requests are processed sequentially instead of rejected.
